d:
What happens when Sunny dreams that his dad can't go to the washroom? Well, the entire family is about to have a very uncomfortable morning!
FilterCopy presents **“Dream Family Episode 3 – Mere Papa Washroom Nahin Ja Sakte!!”** – another day of madness in the life of a cute, chaotic, middle-class Indian family where Sunny, the youngest child, has a rather unusual superpower: whatever he dreams about becomes reality the next morning!
This time, Sunny dreams that his dad gets stuck in a situation where he simply cannot go to the washroom. And guess what? His dream actually comes true!
